title: How to Build an Online Course Platform With AI (No Code Required)
summary: Teachable charges $39/month — plus a 7.5% cut of every sale. Kajabi starts at $149/month. Here's how to build your own online course platform with AI — free to start, no developer needed.
body_markdown: The simplest approach is to paste a YouTube or Vimeo URL into each lesson — the video embeds automatically. If you need direct video hosting, prompt Blink to add file upload and video storage to your platform. Most creators start with YouTube/Vimeo and add direct hosting later.
